experiment: gemma4-26b-a4b fp8-KV flash-DECODE hd512 full-attn kernel tune (PLOW_FP8_FAST) vs vLLM fp8kv

change.scope: fp8 arm only (if constexpr FP8KV); bf16 + shipped-fp8 byte-identical when unset
change.desc: e4m3->f32 direct dequant (drop bf16 round-trip) in FlashDecodeFp8 score+V phases; 8B loads retained (16B PLOW_FP8_LD16 tested+rejected)

rejected_levers.GF8_full_gqa_fusion_1x_traffic: slower at every ctx (128k 0.489 vs 0.415 ms), ~549 GB/s, arithmetic/ILP-bound (8 accum, VU=2), 174 regs no spill
rejected_levers.PLOW_FP8_LD16_16B_loads: wins <=96k (32k -21%) but REGRESSES 128k (+3.3%, HBM-bound), worse slope

tpot_ladder_ms.harness: gemma4_sm120_chat, PLOW_PREFILL=1 warm, 128 gen / n=112 timed, batch 1
tpot_ladder_ms.note: shipped and FAST both measured on this current-main-based build; ~0.05-0.15ms faster than campaign committed (7fd19fb) due to main-drift. vLLM fp8kv = trusted baseline.
tpot_ladder_ms.parity_fast_vs_shipped: PLOW_IDS + step-0 top-5 + argmax IDENTICAL at 32k/64k/96k/128k (device==host AGREE)

verdict.summary: PLOW_FP8_FAST (e4m3->f32 direct dequant) beats vLLM fp8kv at ALL of 32k/64k/96k/128k; flips the campaign's 96k (+0.18) and 128k (+0.33) losses to wins (-0.28 / -0.17).
verdict.recoverable: dequant-ALU half of the 1.8x slope recovered (20.9->18.5 ns/tok); traffic half (GF4 2x KV reread) NOT recoverable (GF8 1x-traffic is compute-bound, slower). plow wins <=128k on lower baseline + reduced slope.
